images.title: North and south on a street map
images.purpose: Show that on a street map up is north and down is south: across the small road above the Basketball Court is the block with the pond and Jaideep's House, and across Market Road below it is the Shopping Centre.
images.composition: A small street map on the left in three bands one above the other (pond block, Basketball Court, Shopping Centre) with a compass card at the top right and three short tags on the right that point at the bands.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 480 and y 55, the heading A small street map in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). MAP CARD: one rounded rectangle (corner radius 20 px), x 100 to 860 and y 100 to 710, white fill, dark #2B2B2B outline 4 px. Inside it, five horizontal bands, each x 120 to 840, stacked from top to bottom with no gaps. BAND 1, the pond block, y 120 to 290, white fill with a thin dark outline (3 px): a pond, one ellipse of 200 by 100 px centred at x 260 and y 205, filled teal #0072B2 with a dark outline; under it, centred at x 260 and y 276, the label Pond (24 px dark); a house on the right, one square body 90 by 50 px at x 560 to 650 and y 215 to 265 filled amber #E69F00 with a dark outline, topped by one triangle roof filled grey #6B7280 with its corners at x 545 and y 215, x 665 and y 215, and x 605 and y 170; above the roof, centred at x 605 and y 150, the label Jaideep's House (26 px dark bold). BAND 2, a small road, y 290 to 340, filled grey #6B7280, no text. BAND 3, the Basketball Court, y 340 to 490, filled amber #E69F00 with a dark outline (3 px); centred at x 480 and y 368 the label Basketball Court (28 px dark bold); below it a court drawn as one white rectangle outline of 300 by 75 px at x 330 to 630 and y 395 to 470 (4 px white line), with one vertical white centre line at x 480 from y 395 to 470 and one white circle of radius 20 centred at x 480 and y 432 (4 px). BAND 4, Market Road, y 490 to 540, filled grey #6B7280, with the label Market Road centred at x 480 and y 515 in white bold sans-serif (30 px). BAND 5, the Shopping Centre, y 540 to 690, filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with a dark outline (3 px); centred at x 480 and y 575 the label Shopping Centre (30 px dark bold); three shops, each one white square of 70 by 60 px with a dark outline (3 px), at x 300 to 370, x 410 to 480 and x 520 to 590, all y 605 to 665. COMPASS: A compass card, a square 110 by 110 px centred at x 1345 and y 135 (x 1290 to 1400, y 80 to 190), white fill, dark #2B2B2B outline 4 px, with N at its top centre, S at its bottom centre and W at its left centre in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (30 px), and E at its right centre in red #D55E00 bold (30 px), and a thin dark cross of two 3 px lines, each 50 px long, centred on the card between the four letters. THREE TAGS on the right, each a rounded rectangle 480 by 100 px (x 920 to 1400) with white fill, a 5 px coloured outline and dark #1F2937 bold text (30 px) centred in it: TAG 1 at y 220 to 320 with a teal #0072B2 outline and the text North of the court: the pond block written on two lines (North of the court: on the first line, the pond block on the second); TAG 2 at y 390 to 490 with an amber #E69F00 outline and the text Start at the court on one line; TAG 3 at y 560 to 660 with a green #009E73 outline and the text South of the court: the Shopping Centre written on two lines (South of the court: on the first line, the Shopping Centre on the second). Three straight connector lines of 5 px with a small arrowhead at the map end, in the colour of their tag: tag 1 from x 920 and y 270 to x 848 and y 215; tag 2 from x 920 and y 440 to x 848 and y 415; tag 3 from x 920 and y 610 to x 848 and y 615. In all: 1 map card, 5 bands, 1 pond, 1 house, 3 shops, 1 court, 1 compass card, 3 tags, 3 connectors. No other text, no digits and nothing else in the frame.
labels: North of the court: the pond block
South of the court: the Shopping Centre
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any change of the order of the three bands, with the pond block at the top, the Basketball Court in the middle and the Shopping Centre at the bottom
a compass with E shown anywhere but on the right, or with the red colour on any letter but E
images.takeaway: Up the map is north and down the map is south: just north of the Basketball Court is the pond block and just south of it, across Market Road, is the Shopping Centre.
images.description: A small street map in three bands: the pond block with Jaideep's House at the top, the Basketball Court in the middle, Market Road and the Shopping Centre at the bottom, with a compass and three tags.
images.context: Concept image for Reading a Street Map. It follows the idea of the street map in your maths book (roads and places seen from above with a compass) and uses the places of this concept's own example, the Basketball Court with the pond block north of it and the Shopping Centre south of it.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student find the court first, then go up and down the map with a finger and say north and south from the compass. The slip to watch: reading up the map as east or west, or forgetting that the compass, not the shape of the picture, says which way is north.

image_decisions.why: A small street map with the compass makes north and south on a map visible, which the words up and down the map alone do not.
